lines.text: Each person went home, but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives and returned early to the temple courts.
The scribes and Pharisees brought a woman caught in adultery and said Moses commanded them to stone her.
They asked this to test Him, but Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
Jesus said the one without sin should cast the first stone, and the accusers left one by one, beginning with the younger ones.
Jesus asked where her accusers were, and she said no one had condemned her, so He told her to go and sin no more.
